# TranscreveAI

> Developer tool that turns public video URLs and media files into evidence-backed knowledge dossiers for agents and developers.

TranscreveAI probes supported sources, analyzes video and audio, extracts transcripts and OCR, generates structured artifacts, and can answer questions grounded in completed runs.

## Product

- [Overview](https://dehor-labs.github.io/transcreve-ai/index.md): Markdown version of the product landing page.
- [Source code](https://github.com/DeHor-Labs/transcreve-ai): repository and technical documentation.
- [Demo](https://dehor-labs.github.io/transcreve-ai/demo/transcreveai-chatgpt-app-demo.mp4): video demonstration of the ChatGPT app workflow.
